facts.fact: At an 8 October 2026 meeting chaired by the posts and telecoms minister with the universal service fund (FDSU) and four operators, a solar microsite solution from Africa Mobile Networks was presented for rural and peri-urban coverage, with 50 pilot sites planned, and the authorities aim to connect 68 million rural people by 2035.

systems.system: Fonds de développement du service universel (FDSU)
